title: Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing
abstract: arXiv:2611.32423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Models read a book, an hour of video, or an image in one forward pass. As the context grows, this pass slows down, loses accuracy, and stops at the context window. Sparse attention is efficient, but keeps the other two limitations. Grid probing, a recent training-free method, recovers the accuracy and extends the reach by asking a frozen model the same question about short local and strided spans of the input, but every question repeats the whole computation, since each span is encoded again. Our insight is that grid probing is emulated attention, an attention pattern reproduced from outside the model through prompts, since each probe only restricts which part of the input the question can see. We introduce Factorized Context Attention (FCA), a training-free block-sparse attention that runs the same pattern natively, as the attention of the model itself. translated_title: 因子化上下文注意力：从模拟探测到原生网格探测
translated_abstract: 模型能够在一次前向传播中读取一本书、一小时的视频或一张图像。随着上下文的增长，这一前向传播会变慢、损失精度，并受限于上下文窗口的长度。稀疏注意力虽然高效，但仍然保留了另外两个局限性。网格探测是一种近期的免训练方法，它通过让冻结模型针对输入的短局部跨度和跨步跨度询问相同的问题，从而恢复精度并扩展可处理的范围；但每个问题都会重复整个计算，因为每个跨度都需要重新编码。我们的洞察是：网格探测本质上是一种“模拟注意力”，即通过提示词在模型外部重现的注意力模式，因为每个探测只是限制了问题能够看到输入的哪一部分。我们提出了因子化上下文注意力，这是一种免训练的块稀疏注意力，它以原生方式运行相同的模式，作为模型自身的注意力。FCA 将输入一次性编码进 KV 缓存，以掩码序列的形式读取所有跨度……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出了免训练的块稀疏注意力方法 FCA，将网格探测这种“模拟注意力”转化为模型原生的注意力机制，只需对输入编码一次进 KV 缓存，即可同时兼顾速度、精度与上下文长度三方面。
en_tdlr: FCA is a training-free block-sparse attention that turns grid probing from an emulated attention pattern into the model's native attention, encoding the input once into a KV cache to jointly address speed, accuracy, and context length.
